name: Dumbbell step-up
definition: Stand facing a fixed platform with a dumbbell in each hand and one foot placed on top. Step onto the platform using the lead leg, then step back down under control.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand facing a fixed platform with a dumbbell in each hand and one foot placed on top.
value.movement: Step onto the platform using the lead leg, then step back down under control.
value.finish: Return to the original floor position and retain the same lead leg for counting.
value.range_of_motion: Record platform height; finish the ascent standing on the platform before descending.
